summary: VEON MidCo B.V., a subsidiary of VEON Ltd., announced early results of a cash tender offer for its outstanding 3.375% Notes due 2027 (ISINs: XS2824764521 / XS2824766146), originally $1,013,973,000 in principal. Holders tendered $936,022,000 principal amount by the Early Tender Deadline; the company accepted $886,075,000 at an Early Tender Offer Purchase Price of $987.50 per $1,000, exceeding the Maximum Aggregate Purchase Price of $875,000,000. No further tenders will be accepted. The offer was subject to a New Financing Condition. This liability management transaction reduces debt overhang and near-term maturities; watch for the closing and new financing terms.
